# CellVerticalAlignment

```csharp
public enum CellVerticalAlignment
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

Where a cell's text sits from top to bottom of the cell.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="top"></a>`Top` | 0 | Against the top edge. |
| <a id="center"></a>`Center` | 1 | In the middle. |
| <a id="bottom"></a>`Bottom` | 2 | Against the bottom edge, Excel's default. |
| <a id="justify"></a>`Justify` | 3 | Lines spread to the top and bottom edges. |
| <a id="distributed"></a>`Distributed` | 4 | Lines spread evenly from top to bottom. |
